pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-pointed geometric shapes with sharp, jagged edge gradients. Patches on the flank exhibit star-like projections with high pixel contrast relative to the inter-patch regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Complex topological network of light-colored negative space featuring numerous Y-shaped junction nodes. The pathways show variable pixel thickness, tapering at intersections and widening along the lateral boundaries.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck, characteristic of a short, uniform bristly texture against the background.
